lineComments: Short action label, says what the button does.
Clear option to revert to automatic detection.
Clear label for marking a period as not sleep.

rows.comment: 'Re-analysing' differs from the 'Recalculate this night' button that triggers it. Use the same verb.
rows.replacement: 'Recalculating this night…'

rows.comment: Correct but wordy. State the two options directly.
rows.replacement: 'Apply these times to this night only, or use them as your expected sleep schedule.'

rows.comment: 'Please' is filler; give the recovery step as an instruction.
rows.replacement: 'Sleep calculation failed. Try again.'

rows.comment: 'Insufficient' is stiff and does not say what is short.
lineComments: Name the missing thing: recorded data.
rows.replacement: 'Times saved. Not enough data was recorded in that window to compute sleep metrics.'

rows.comment: 'Hypnogram' is undefined jargon for most readers.
rows.replacement: 'No sleep stage chart for this night'

rows.comment: 'One was missing' is a clipped fragment; say which condition failed.
rows.replacement: 'Staging needs both movement and beat timing, and one of them is missing.'

rows.comment: Fragment of a larger conditional expression; the visible text is plain and carries a count.
lineComments: Instruction to use the chart, then the cycle count.
Start of the singular/plural branch, cannot be judged alone.

rows.comment: Fragment of the same conditional expression as the previous row.
lineComments: Instruction to use the chart, then the cycle count.
Start of the singular/plural branch, cannot be judged alone.

rows.comment: Fragment giving cycle length with a computed value.
lineComments: Closes the plural branch and prints the mean cycle length.

rows.comment: 'any moment' is vague. Say what tapping gives you.
rows.replacement: 'Tap or drag the chart to see the values at that moment.'

rows.comment: 'Invisible to a wrist' is a flourish. The fact is the 5-minute threshold.
lineComments: Replace the figure of speech with a plain statement.
rows.replacement:
'No wake-ups of 5 minutes or more. '
'Shorter ones are not detected.'

rows.comment: Fragment of a plural conditional; cannot be judged alone and is plain.
lineComments: Starts the sentence with the wake-up count.

rows.comment: Same 'invisible to a wrist' flourish; keep the 5-minute threshold.
lineComments: Plain statement instead of the figure of speech.
rows.replacement:
'} of 5 minutes or more. '
'Shorter ones are not detected.'

rows.comment: Scrub readout with a computed percentage.
Empty-state title, states what is missing.
Gives the reason for the empty state.
Em dash and 'the better we saw the night' are loose. State that the range narrows with more recorded data.
lineComments: Replace the antithesis and em dash with one statement.
Keep the stage-width facts as short sentences.
Keep the pointer to Nerd stats.
rows.replacement:
'Each stage shows a range that narrows when more of the night was recorded. '
'Deep has the widest range. Awake is one figure. '
'Nerd stats has the exact counts.'

rows.comment: Metric label, describes what is measured.
Defines the bar precisely (middle half of the user's nights).
Em dash. Split into two sentences, keep the numbers.
lineComments: Comma instead of em dash, same comparison.
Separate sentence for the lowest value.
rows.replacement:
'$noun ${fmt(v)}, lower than any of your last ${hist.length} '
'nights. The lowest was ${fmt(lo)}.'

rows.comment: Em dash. Split into two sentences, keep the numbers.
lineComments: Comma instead of em dash, same comparison.
Separate sentence for the highest value.
rows.replacement:
'$noun ${fmt(v)}, higher than any of your last ${hist.length} '
'nights. The highest was ${fmt(hi)}.'

rows.comment: Em dash and a fused clause. The 'not a diagnosis' line is a health disclaimer and stays.
lineComments: Make the causes a full sentence.
Keep the disclaimer as its own sentence.
rows.replacement:
'${vsBase.toStringAsFixed(1)} bpm above your own baseline. This often follows '
'alcohol, a late meal, a hard session or the start of an infection. '
'It is a measurement, not a diagnosis.'

rows.comment: States the state of the data.

rows.replacement: 'No personal range yet. ${history.length} of $_minNights nights recorded.'

rows.comment: 'Pick one and go' is a cute fragment. Say what the user picks.
rows.replacement: 'Pick a session'

rows.comment: Section label for starting a session.
Same cute fragment as in start_card.dart.
rows.replacement: 'Pick a session'

rows.comment: 'Write the day down' is a figure of speech. Name the action.
rows.replacement: 'Log your day'

rows.comment: Passive and wordy. Name the source and the result.
lineComments: Active voice: stress comes from beat timing.
Short second sentence about last night.
rows.replacement:
'Stress comes from beat timing recorded while you rest overnight. '
'Last night had no reading.'
'Overnight stress'

rows.comment: 'Down against your own need' is awkward. Say short of your sleep need.
lineComments: Tonight's need as its own sentence.
rows.replacement:
'You are ${_hm(debtH * 60)} short of your sleep need. '
'Tonight\'s need is ${_hm(needSec / 60)}.'

rows.comment: 'Cost you' is dramatic. Name the action.
rows.replacement: 'Review last night'

rows.comment: 'Charged and drained' is metaphor. Say what the drivers do to readiness.
rows.replacement: 'What raised and lowered your readiness'

rows.comment: 'Know what normal looks like' is soft. Say that a baseline needs enough nights.
rows.replacement:
'Readiness drivers need enough nights to '
'set your baseline.'

rows.comment: Convoluted negative. State that need could not be calculated from recorded data.
lineComments: Closing fragment is no longer needed.
rows.replacement:
'Tonight\'s sleep need could not be '
'calculated from the recorded data.'
